about.name: Coach Trent Carlson
about.title: DC
about.bio:
Coach Trent Carlson is a proven 37744 specialist with 4 years of coaching experience at MACCRAY HS. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Carlson develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Carlson's coaching is where that journey starts.

services.title: 37744 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 37744 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
